Commentary.Commentary: We are back! The players are also back on the field. Chamari Atapattu and Vishmi Gunaratne are the Sri Lankan openers. It's going to be Renuka Singh to open the bowling for India Women. Here we go...
...THE RUN CHASE…

Sri Lanka Women bowled with good control but there were phases when they allowed things to drift away. Still, most of their bowlers fared decently and a combined effort from them has restricted India Women below 150. That said, this is exactly the target that the hosts were after in the first T20I but fell short by 34 runs. Can they do better and avoid a clean sweep? Do join us in a short while to find out.

After choosing to bat first, India Women lost Shafali Verma cheaply but the pair of Smriti Mandhana and Sabbhineni Meghana put on a stand and helped the touring team in getting 37 runs from the Powerplay. Just when the duo looked set to take control, both departed in quick succession and India Women were forced to rebuild. Harmanpreet Kaur and Jemimah Rodrigues started off slowly as they focused on the rotation of the strike and then went on to construct a 64-run stand, off 56 balls. The latter departed in the end overs, otherwise India Women could have breached the 150-run mark.

The final over fetched India Women 16 runs and they have ended up with a challenging total on the board. A handy cameo by Pooja Vastrakar towards the end and it was a handy partnership between her and Harmanpreet Kaur at the backend.

OUT! RUN OUT! Pooja Vastrakar is dropped in the deep but Sri Lanka get a wicket courtesy of a run out! This is fuller on leg, Pooja Vastrakar looks to go big down the ground. However, she miscues it and the ball goes high in the air towards long on. Nilakshi de Silva misjudges it and fails to catch the ball in the end. Harshitha Madavi, who has come from deep mid-wicket, collects the ball quickly and fires a throw at the bowler's end. The batters look to take three runs but Pooja Vastrakar is short of her crease as Chamari Atapattu whips the bails off at the bowler's end. India Women finish with 138/5 in 20 overs!
Appeal for a run out...

FOUR! This has been a good over for India, another boundary! Fuller delivery on middle, Pooja Vastrakar hurries down the track and whips it hard towards wide long on. The fielder there misfields a little and the ball crosses the fence.
FOUR! Now, Pooja Vastrakar joins the act! This is outside off. Pooja Vastrakar walks down the track and hits it over the cover fielder in the ring for a boundary.
Kaur skips down the track and pulls this short delivery to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Another boundary for Kaur! This is tossed up on off, Harmanpreet Kaur skips down the track and hits it inside-out over extra-cover for a boundary.
A shorter-length delivery, on off. Pooja backs away and cuts it to the fielder at covers. A partial stop is made and they cross.
FOUR! Very nice shot to end the over! A yorker, outside off. Kaur opens the face of her blade at the last moment and guides it through the vacant gully region for a boundary.
A low full toss on off, Harmanpreet Kaur makes room but hits it back to the bowler.
A full toss on off. Pooja Vastrakar only manages to hit it to long on, along the ground, for a single.
On middle and very full. Kaur digs it out behind square on the leg side for a single.
A fuller delivery on off. Pooja pushes it towards the off side. However, the fielder has a shy at the batter's end and misses. An overthrow allows a single.
Jemimah Rodrigues exits and Pooja Vastrakar has joined her skipper in the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Ama Kanchana comes back into the attack and gets a wicket straight away! This is full on off, Jemimah Rodrigues looks to take the advantage of the fielder at fine leg being inside the circle. She paddles it but aerially and hits it straight to Vishmi Gunaratne at short fine leg. A timely breakthrough for Sri Lanka Women.
Commentary.Howout: c Vishmi Gunaratne b Ama Kanchana

Commentary.Commentary: Change in bowling. Ama Kanchana to bowl at the death. 0 for 15 in her 3 overs so far.
Shorter delivery on middle, Jemimah Rodrigues pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.

Missed stumping chance! Tossed up, around leg. Jemimah Rodrigues skips down the track and swings across the line. She misses. However, the keeper fails to collect it cleanly and Jemimah Rodrigues gets back in her crease.

Good running between the wickets! This is fuller on middle, Jemimah Rodrigues sweeps it to deep mid-wicket and comes back for the second run. She has to rush for the second run but puts in a dive and makes it safely.
Tossed up on off, Kaur skips down the track and drives it uppishly past the left side of the diving bowler to long off, for a single.
Kaur misses out there! This is fuller on leg, Kaur paddles it but straight to the short fine-leg fielder. Either side of that fielder and it would have been a boundary.
A slightly shorter delivery on middle, Jemimah Rodrigues heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Chamari Atapattu has brought herself into the attack.
A fuller delivery on middle. Jemimah Rodrigues knocks it down to long on for a single. Another good over for India, 12 from it.
Flatter delivery on middle. Kaur sweeps but gets just a single to deep square leg this time.
SIX! This time she connects properly and slams it over the fence! On middle. Kaur gets on her knees and slog-sweeps it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
Flatter and quicker delivery, around off. Jemimah Rodrigues pushes it to cover-point for a single.

Not off the middle of the blade again! This is tossed up on middle. Kaur dances down the track and looks to hit it hard but probably gets the bottom of her blade and the ball goes to long off for a single.
WIDE! Inoka Ranaweera drifts down the leg side. Kaur looks to paddle it away but misses. 100 up!

Angling into leg. Jemimah Rodrigues clips it to short fine leg and sets off for a single. There is a direct hit at the batter's end and after an appeal, the umpire takes it upstairs. However, the replays show that Kaur is well inside the crease and a single is completed.
Angling into leg and flatter. Jemimah Rodrigues works it to mid-wicket for a single. 9 from the over but 150 looks tough from hereon for India.
FOUR! Lovely shot! This is tossed up on middle. Jemimah Rodrigues makes a bit of room as she skips down the track and plays it inside-out over extra cover for a boundary.
Slower through the air on middle, Kaur looks to defend but gets the inside half of her blade. The ball goes behind square on the leg side and a single is taken.
Pulls her length back a bit. Turning into leg. Jemimah Rodrigues works it off the back foot to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, around off. Kaur dances down the track and hits it hard but straight to long on for another single.
Skips down the track to this delivery on middle and works it away to long on for a single.
A yorker around middle, Kaur was lining up for a big shot but all she manages is to dig it out at the last moment. 8 from the over, 30 more balls left in the innings, can India Women reach 150?
FOUR! Well placed and beats the diving fielder in the deep. Short in length and around off, Harmanpreet Kaur goes on the back foot and muscles her pull shot behind square leg for a boundary.
Skips down the track to a full ball and forces it to long on for a single.
Tossed up, around off, Kaur sweeps it to deep square leg for a run.
Fires it in, full and around leg, Jemimah Rodrigues fails to flick and it goes off her pads to square leg. They cross for a leg bye.
Inoka bowls it a touch short and around off, Kaur eases it to square leg and picks up a single.
Inoka Ranaweera is back on. Two overs for 12 runs with one wicket of Sabbhineni Meghana so far.
Floated delivery, a low full toss on middle, Kaur flicks it through mid-wicket for a single. 9 from the over!
Around leg, on a fuller length, it's helped to mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Fine shot! Flighted delivery, full and outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues skips down the track and powers it over the bowler's head. The long on fielder tries her best with a dive but fails to cut it off.
Fetches a full ball from outside off and sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Goes down on one knee and plays a mistimed slog down the ground. It goes on one bounce to the long on fielder. They cross.
Floated and full, around middle, Harmanpreet Kaur walks forward to whip it over mid-wicket but it takes the inner edge and rolls through square leg for a run.
Kavisha Dilhari is back into the attack. She has bowled one over for four runs so far.
FOUR! The final delivery of Sugandika Kumari's spell goes for a boundary. A juicy full toss outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues smacks it in the gap at covers, beats the infield and finds the fence.
A very full delivery, outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues digs it out to the left of the bowler. A good stop by Kumari.
Aerial but safe! Fuller in length and around off, Harmanpreet Kaur slog-sweeps it over mid-wicket and it falls wide of the fielder in the deep. They take another single.
Shortish and on off, Jemimah punches it down to long on for a run.
Another arm ball, short and outside off, Kaur taps it down in front of backward point for a brisk single.
Arm ball, short and around off, Jemimah Rodrigues goes deep inside the crease and drags it past the diving bowler to long on. A single is taken.
Sugandika Kumari comes back for her last over. Three overs for 20 runs so far with a wicket of Shafali Verma under her kitty.
Flighted and too full around off, Jemimah Rodrigues sweeps behind square leg and retains strike with a single. A very slow recovery from India Women after losing two set batters in consecutive overs.
Short in length and wide outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues cuts it to the right of the point fielder. A good diving stop, another dot.
Kaur connects with her sweep shot this time and sends it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Harmanpreet Kaur has been hit on her helmet! The physio is out for the mandatory concussion test. She looks fine though and is ready to resume.
Hit on the helmet! Some extra bounce there. Tossed up, outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur goes down to sweep but it bounces a tad extra and pings her on the helmet.
Flatter and shorter, on middle, worked in front of square on the leg side for a run.

Flighted and full, outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur advances down the track and pushes it gently to point. She looks for a run but is sent back. The fielder misses her shy at the striker's end, the keeper has not collect it and they cross for an overthrow.
In the air... Full in length, around leg, Harmanpreet Kaur flicks it aerially over mid-wicket and it goes on one bounce to the fielder in the deep. They take one.
Fuller in length and outside off, Kaur drives but finds the mid off fielder. Two dots.
Slower delivery, on a length around off, Harmanpreet Kaur defends it on the leg side.
A low full toss around leg, Jemimah Rodrigues tickles it gently through mid-wicket and eyes two runs. Gets just one though.
Very full and on middle, it's eased through mid-wicket for one.
Lands it full and around leg, Jemimah Rodrigues flicks it aerially towards wide long on for a run.
Ama Kanchana comes back into the attack. 0 for 11 in her 2 overs so far.
On middle and fuller. Jemimah Rodrigues uses her wrists and works it away towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Beaten! This is pushed quicker and outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues pushes forward to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Fuller on middle. Kaur drives it to long on for a single this time.
Keeps floating up nicely in the air, on off. Kaur only manages to work it back to the bowler.
She bowls it slower through the air, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues just pushes it gently towards covers for a single.
Nicely flighted delivery on off, Kaur works it to long on for a single.
Kavisha Dilhari comes into the attack.
This is fuller on middle. Jemimah Rodrigues drives it to the right of the bowler. Very good over for Sri Lanka Women, just 3 from it and a big wicket.
WIDE! Inoka Ranaweera drifts down the leg side. Jemimah Rodrigues looks to clip it but misses.
Two wickets in two overs and India Women are in a spot of bother. In walks Jemimah Rodrigues.

OUT! CAUGHT! The pressure was building with quite a few dot balls and Sabbhineni Meghana perishes while trying to force the issue. This is tossed up on off. Sabbhineni Meghana skips down the track and looks to go inside-out over covers. However, just like Shafali Verma, she does not get the elevation and hands a straight forward catch to Chamari Atapattu at extra cover.
Commentary.Howout: c Chamari Atapattu b Inoka Ranaweera

Commentary.Commentary: Goes quicker on off. Sabbhineni Meghana blocks it out.
This is flatter and around off. Sabbhineni Meghana pushes it towards point.
A fuller delivery on middle, Kaur pushes it to long on for a single.
Forces a full ball down to long off for a single. 50 up!
Good turn again! This is pitched around off. Kaur looks to push it off the front foot. However, the ball turns and beats the outside edge of her blade.
A fuller delivery on middle. Sabbhineni Meghana works it to long on for a single.
Harmanpreet Kaur walks in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Oshadi Ranasinghe strikes and gets rid of the dangerous Smriti Mandhana! This is tossed up nicely, again on off, Smriti Mandhana dances down the track and looks to go big. However, she miscues it completely and gets it away off the toe end of her bat. The ball goes high in the air towards long off and Nilakshi de Silva running in from the fence takes a fine catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Nilakshi de Silva b Oshadi Ranasinghe

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up on off. Sabbhineni Meghana looks to go big down the ground. However, she miscues it and the ball falls in the vacant mid on region. The batters cross.
Pitches it outside off and it turns away a bit. Sabbhineni Meghana looks to cut it late but misses.
Tossed up on off. Smriti Mandhana slog-sweeps it again along the ground towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Change in bowling. Ama Kanchana has been replaced by Oshadi Ranasinghe from this end.
Fuller and around off. Sabbhineni Meghana drives it firmly towards covers. The fielder runs across and half-stops it. Two runs are taken in the end. Good over for India, 9 from it!
Slower through the air on middle, Sabbhineni Meghana drives it back to the bowler.
Tossed-up delivery on middle, Smriti Mandhana slog-sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
This is flatter and around off, Smriti Mandhana tries to punch it away but misses.

FOUR! That is Smriti Mandhana at her best! She skips down the track and Inoka Ranaweera pulls her length back a bit and bowls it outside off. Smriti Mandhana adjusts and lofts it delightfully over extra cover for a boundary.
This is fuller on off. Sabbhineni Meghana drives it firmly but straight to the cover fielder. Chamari Atapattu there fails to stop it cleanly and a single is taken.
WIDE! Inoka Ranaweera drifts down the leg side. Sabbhineni Meghana looks to sweep but misses.
The field restriction is lifted now. Inoka Ranaweera is introduced into the attack.

FOUR! Boundary to finish the Powerplay! India are 37/1 after 6 overs! Bowls a fullish length, around middle, Smriti Mandhana makes space and drives it beautifully through cover-point for a boundary. Plenty of bottom hand behind that shot.
Too early into her shot! This is full, outside off. Smriti Mandhana looks to drive it away but gets the inside half of her blade. The ball rolls back to the bowler.
Fullish delivery that is drifting on the pads. Sabbhineni Meghana flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Sabbhineni Meghana will always score her runs at a brisk rate! This is fuller on middle, Sabbhineni Meghana lifts it straight down the ground for a boundary as the mid off fielder gives the chase.
Back of a length, on leg. Smriti Mandhana works it away towards short fine leg where the fielder fumbles and allows a single.

Ohh...almost drags it back onto the stumps! A length delivery, outside off. Smriti Mandhana goes for a big drive away from her body but gets an inside edge. The ball goes past the stumps and rolls towards the leg side.
Flighted delivery, full and around off, Smriti Mandhana goes down and slog-sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for just a single.
Works a full ball off her pads to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Slower one, full and outside off, Sabbhineni Meghana looks to step down but then stops and attempts to drive. Misses.
Floated delivery, full and around off, Sabbhineni Meghana pushes it down to mid off.

FOUR! Misfield inside the ring. Too full in length and wide outside off, Sabbhineni Meghana exercises her arms and strokes it firmly through the cover region for a boundary. That fielder was lazy in getting down.
Quicker through the air, around off and skidding in, Sabbhineni Meghana defends it back to the bowler.
Slower through the air, full and wide outside off, Smriti mistimes her drive back in the direction of the bowler. It's been a watchful start from India Women!
Skidding in again, from around off, Smriti Mandhana makes room and cuts but this time finds the fielder at cover-point.
Flighted this time, full and on off, Sabbhineni Meghana knocks it down to long on and picks up a run.
Loopy and full, outside off, Meghana gets on the front foot and pushes it to covers.
Skidding into the batter, from around off, Smriti Mandhana works it to deep mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
FOUR! Superb placement. Short in length and outside off, Smriti Mandhana rocks back and cuts it through the gap at cover-point. Finding the gap was the key and Mandhana did that with aplomb.
Oshadi Ranasinghe is into the attack now.
Arm ball, landing short and on off, it skids on after pitching and Sabbhineni Meghana punches it from the back foot to covers. 7 from this over!
FOUR! Finds the gap! Very full in length and outside off, Sabbhineni Meghana latches onto the width and drills her drive through the gap at covers for a boundary.
Tossed up, full and around middle, Sabbhineni Meghana digs it out back towards the bowler.
Very full and on the pads, it's been flicked easily to deep mid-wicket for one.
Slower through the air, full and wide outside off, Sabbhineni Meghana tries to drive but ends up dragging it off the inner edge to deep mid-wicket. They get another single.
A touch flatter and shorter, around off, Smriti Mandhana stays on the back foot and punches it through wide mid on for a single.
Fullish and around off, shaping away, Meghana drives from the middle of her bat but finds the mid off fielder. Just 1 from the over.
Nice and straight, on a fuller length, Sabbhineni Meghana gets behind the line and pushes it towards mid on.
A swinging full toss, outside off and curling away, Sabbhineni Meghana allows it through to the keeper.
Very full this time, around middle, Mandhana comes down the track and wrists it through mid-wicket for a single.
Pitches it up and around off, Smriti Mandhana drives but finds the fielder at mid off.
Ama Kanchana begins with a short ball on middle, Smriti Mandhana turns and pulls but finds the short fine leg fielder.
Sabbhineni Meghana walks out at number 3 and it will be pace from the other end now. Ama Kanchana to bowl the second over.

OUT! CAUGHT! Sugandika Kumari tosses this up and lands it full around off, Shafali Verma walks forward with the intention to power it over the infield on the off side. She fails to get the required elevation though and Chamari Atapattu accepts an easy catch at covers. Early exit for Shafali Verma!
Commentary.Howout: c Chamari Atapattu b Sugandika Kumari

Commentary.Commentary: A stifled appeal for an lbw! Not given. An arm ball, landing around middle and skidding down, Shafali Verma tries to flick but misses.

EDGY FOUR! Sugandika Kumari is yet to land her delivery. Make it four full tosses, around middle, Shafali Verma walks down the track for a big shot down the ground but it takes a thick outside edge off her bat and races down to third man for a boundary.
On the pads, again a full toss, Mandhana clips it to deep mid-wicket and gets another run.
Yet another full toss, around middle, Shafali Verma tickles it to deep mid-wicket and she is also off the mark with a single.
Sugandika Kumari starts with a low full toss on middle, Smriti Mandhana flicks it wide of mid on and opens her account with a single.

We are all set to begin! The Sri Lanka Women players are out there in the middle. Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma are the openers for India Women. It will be spin first up from Sri Lanka Women. Sugandika Kumari to start with the ball. Here we go...

Chamari Atapattu, the captain of Sri Lanka Women, says that she would have liked to bowl first anyway and they would look to bowl well now. Tells that they batted well at the top of the order in the last game but could not capitalise. Mentions that 140 would be a good score on this pitch and informs that they have two changes in their playing XI.

Harmanpreet Kaur, the captain of India Women, says that they want to bat first and informs that they have opted for the same XI. Adds that whatever they have decided in the team meeting is getting executed and their focus in this match will be on their batting and getting the partnerships.

Pitch report - Brilliant conditions out in the middle, the sun is out in force and it's a bit warmer than the last time. There is a nice breeze blowing across the stadium. A fresh pitch is to be used and the grass is nicely rolled. It will have a little bit of pace and the spinners might have a tough task making the ball spin here.

Sri Lanka Women (Playing XI) - Chamari Atapattu (C), Vishmi Gunaratne, Harshitha Madavi, Nilakshi de Silva, Kavisha Dilhari, Ama Kanchana (In place of Hasini Perera), Anushka Sanjeewani (WK), Malsha Shehani (In place of Udeshika Prabodhani), Oshadi Ranasinghe, Sugandika Kumari, Inoka Ranaweera.

India Women (Unchanged Playing XI) - Smriti Mandhana, Shafali Verma, Sabbhineni Meghana, Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Jemimah Rodrigues, Yastika Bhatia (WK), Deepti Sharma, Simran Bahadur, Pooja Vastrakar, Renuka Singh, Radha Yadav.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Harmanpreet Kaur. India Women have elected to BAT first.

Sri Lanka, on the other hand, are a growing unit. They depend a lot on their skipper, Chamari Atapattu but with young players like Vishmi Gunaratne and Kavisha Dilhari showing their potential lately, they seem to be moving in the right direction. However, the lack of firepower in the batting department once Chamari Atapattu departs remains a big concern. Their bowling has been pretty good in this series but they need to be a lot better as a unit to outclass India Women here. The question now is, can they level up their game further and end the series on a high? Let's find out. Toss and team news in a bit.
